title: Compare both chromosomes from two Vibrio assemblies
summary: Arrange four chromosomes from Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio alginolyticus as two Linear rows, run LOSATP collinear analysis between the rows, and color the resulting blocks by orientation and identity.

downloads.label: Vibrio parahaemolyticus RIMD 2210633
downloads.note: Download the RefSeq genomic GBFF; the tutorial uses both chromosomes.

downloads.label: Vibrio alginolyticus NBRC 15630
downloads.note: Download the RefSeq genomic GBFF; the tutorial uses both chromosomes.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear before adding the assemblies.

media.caption: Select Linear before adding the multi-record inputs.

manualSteps.title: Add all four chromosomes
manualSteps.body: Add one Linear input row per chromosome. Reuse each assembly GBFF in the rows listed below, then choose the matching accession in Record. Enter the species markup only on the first chromosome of each row and enter the strain in Subtitle / title; leave both fields empty for the second chromosome.
manualSteps.note: Both assemblies contain two chromosomes, and all four chromosomes are included.

media.alt: First Vibrio record card with Record options open, NC_004603.1 selected, Vibrio parahaemolyticus entered, and RIMD 2210633 entered as the subtitle.
media.caption: Upload the RIMD 2210633 GBFF, open Record options, select NC_004603.1, and enter the species and strain text.

actions.script: () => { const select = document.querySelector("select[aria-label='Record selector for sequence 1']"); return select && !select.disabled && [...select.options].some((option) => option.value === 'NC_004603.1'); }

const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (!app || app.linearSeqs?.length !== 4) throw new Error('Expected four restored Linear records.'); app.sidebarWidth = 480; const seq = app.linearSeqs[0]; if (!seq?.gb?.name?.includes('GCF_000196095.1_ASM19609v1_genomic.gbff')) throw new Error('First restored GenBank file does not match the tutorial.'); seq.region_record_id = 'NC_004603.1'; seq.definition = 'Vibrio parahaemolyticus'; seq.record_subtitle = 'RIMD 2210633'; const row = document.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-card="${seq.uid}"]`); const options = row?.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-options="${seq.uid}"]`); if (!row || !options) throw new Error('First Linear record card is unavailable.'); options.open = true; row.setAttribute('data-capture-tutorial-record-row', 'true'); row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Arrange one species per row
manualSteps.body: Turn on Arrange in rows. Assign the row numbers from the replicon table, retain the listed input order for left-to-right columns, and set Record gap to 48 px.

media.alt: Record Layout controls with Arrange in rows enabled and the four chromosomes assigned to rows 1, 1, 2, and 2.
media.caption: Open Advanced comparison and layout, then assign each species' chromosome pair to its own row.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-label^="Linear record row for sequence"]')]; const expected = '1,1,2,2'; if (inputs.map((node) => node.value).join(',') !== expected) throw new Error('Restored row assignments do not match the tutorial.'); const heading = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-advanced-comparison] .linear-primary-label')].find((node) => node.textContent?.trim() === 'Record Layout'); const panel = heading?.parentElement; const rows = inputs.map((node) => node.parentElement); if (!heading || !panel || rows.some((row) => !row)) throw new Error('Record Layout controls are unavailable.'); heading.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-heading', 'true'); rows.forEach((row, index) => row.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-row', String(index + 1))); const gap = [...panel.querySelectorAll('label')].find((node) => node.textContent?.includes('Record gap')); gap?.setAttribute('data-capture-record-layout-gap', 'true'); heading.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Run LOSATP in Collinear blocks mode
manualSteps.body: In Comparison, choose Run LOSAT, open Settings, set LOSAT Mode to LOSATP and LOSATP mode to Collinear blocks, then use Adjacent pairs as evidence. Diagonal drift is under Advanced comparison and layout.
manualSteps.note: With multi-record rows, Adjacent pairs searches every cross-record combination between neighboring rows. This layout evaluates four chromosome pairs across one species boundary; same-row pairs are omitted.

media.alt: Comparison card with Run LOSAT active, Current: Run LOSAT status, closed Settings, and the Selected pairs disclosure.
media.caption: Choose Run LOSAT to activate comparisons across adjacent display rows.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); }

media.alt: Vibrio Comparison Settings showing all three LOSAT Mode buttons with LOSATP pressed and the LOSATP mode menu open with Collinear blocks highlighted.
media.caption: Press LOSATP, then open LOSATP mode and choose the highlighted Collinear blocks option.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); }

media.alt: Vibrio Comparison Settings with the Color mode menu open and Orientation + identity highlighted.
media.caption: Open Color mode in Settings and choose the highlighted Orientation + identity option.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); app.losat.blastp.collinearColorMode = 'orientation_identity'; }

media.alt: Vibrio Comparison Settings with the Evidence scope menu open and Adjacent pairs highlighted.
media.caption: Open Evidence scope in Settings and choose the highlighted Adjacent pairs option.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); const blastp = app.losat?.blastp; if (Number(blastp?.collinearMinAnchors) !== 3 || Number(blastp?.collinearMaxUnitGap) !== 2 || Number(blastp?.collinearMaxDiagonalDrift) !== 2 || blastp?.collinearColorMode !== 'orientation_identity' || blastp?.collinearSearchScope !== 'adjacent') throw new Error(`Restored collinear settings do not match the tutorial: ${JSON.stringify(blastp)}`); }

media.alt: Vibrio Advanced collinear search controls with Diagonal drift set to 2.
media.caption: Open Advanced comparison and layout and set Diagonal drift to 2 under Advanced collinear search.

actions.script: async () => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; await app.setLinearComparisonGlobalAction('losat'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatMode('blastp'); app.setLinearComparisonLosatpMode('collinear'); app.losat.blastp.collinearMaxDiagonalDrift = 2; }

const section = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-advanced-comparison] section')).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Advanced collinear search')); if (!section) throw new Error('Advanced collinear search was not found.'); section.dataset.capture = 'vibrio-advanced-collinear'; section.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Render every feature as a rectangle
manualSteps.body: Keep the seven default Linear feature types and set each shape selector to Rectangle.

media.alt: Features card with CDS, rRNA, tRNA, tmRNA, ncRNA, misc_RNA, and repeat_region all set to Rectangle.
media.caption: Set every selected feature type to Rectangle.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const features = ['CDS','rRNA','tRNA','tmRNA','ncRNA','misc_RNA','repeat_region']; if (!features.every((name) => app?.getFeatureShape?.(name) === 'rectangle')) throw new Error('Restored feature shapes are not all rectangles.'); const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card')].find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Features')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const section = card?.querySelector('details > div > div'); if (!summary || !section) throw new Error('Feature shape controls are unavailable.'); summary.setAttribute('data-capture-feature-summary', 'true'); section.setAttribute('data-capture-feature-shapes', 'true'); section.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Set the Linear layout and definitions
manualSteps.body: Use Above track layout, separate the strands, and turn on Lock Definition Column. Use a ruler with 750,000 bp spacing. In Titles & Record Labels, turn off Replicon and set Accession and Length / Coordinates to Hide so each left definition contains only the species and strain lines. Set the species line to 18 px Bold and the strain line to 16 px Normal. The two-line definition is centered on the feature record itself, independent of the Axis and ruler.

media.alt: Layout card with Above track layout, Separate Strands, and Lock Definition Column selected.
media.caption: Use Above tracks, separate the strands, and lock the definition column.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; if (app?.form?.linear_track_layout !== 'above' || app?.form?.separate_strands !== true || app?.form?.keep_definition_left_aligned !== true) throw new Error('Restored Linear layout does not match the tutorial.'); const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card')].find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Layout')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const content = card?.querySelector('details > div'); const track = content?.children?.[0]; const options = content?.children?.[1]; if (!summary || !track || !options) throw new Error('Layout controls are unavailable.'); summary.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-summary', 'true'); track.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-track', 'true'); options.setAttribute('data-capture-linear-layout-options', 'true'); track.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Place the legend at the bottom and leave the title blank
manualSteps.body: Leave Plot Title empty and set Legend position to Bottom.

media.alt: Legend card with the Position menu open and Bottom highlighted.
media.caption: Choose Bottom for Legend position.

manualSteps.title: Generate and inspect the multi-record diagram
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The bundled Gallery session already contains the completed result for immediate inspection. The preview should show two species rows, four record-local rulers, rectangular features, and orientation-and-identity collinear blocks at their shared boundary. Each left-aligned two-line definition remains centered on the feature record rather than the ruler. A narrow white gap separates each record from the blocks, including when feature labels are hidden. The Gallery preview uses an interactive SVG with internally compressed metadata, so you can click a feature or collinear block to inspect its embedded metadata.

media.alt: Generated two-row Vibrio diagram with four chromosomes and orientation-and-identity collinear blocks.
media.caption: The completed title-free diagram retains all four chromosomes, centers each 18 px bold species name and 16 px strain name on its feature row, preserves the Axis-sized gap around the collinear block band, and places the legend below the final row.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const rows = Array.isArray(app?.linearRecordRows) ? app.linearRecordRows.map((entry) => Number(entry?.row)) : []; if (JSON.stringify(rows) !== JSON.stringify([1, 1, 2, 2])) throw new Error('Restored Vibrio row placement does not match the tutorial.'); const content = String(app?.results?.[0]?.content || ''); const svg = app?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg || !content.includes('Vibrio parahaemolyticus') || !content.includes('Vibrio alginolyticus') || !content.includes('Collinear') || !content.includes('Inverted') || svg.getElementById('plot_title')) throw new Error('Restored title-free Vibrio collinear SVG does not match the tutorial.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 0.55; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 0; app.canvasPan.y = 0; } svg.setAttribute('data-capture-vibrio-overview', 'true');

() => { const svg = window.__GBDRAW_APP__?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); const featureLegend = svg?.getElementById('feature_legend_h'); const pairwiseLegend = svg?.getElementById('legend_horizontal')?.querySelector('[data-gbdraw-role="comparison-legend"][data-gbdraw-orientation="h"], #pairwise_legend_h, #pairwise_legend'); if (!featureLegend || !pairwiseLegend || svg.getElementById('plot_title')) return false; const matrix = (node) => node.transform?.baseVal?.consolidate()?.matrix || { e: 0, f: 0 }; const featureMatrix = matrix(featureLegend); const pairwiseMatrix = matrix(pairwiseLegend); const featureBox = featureLegend.getBBox(); const pairwiseBox = pairwiseLegend.getBBox(); const horizontalGap = pairwiseMatrix.e + pairwiseBox.x - (featureMatrix.e + featureBox.x + featureBox.width); return horizontalGap >= 20; }

losatTips.title: Load the session for immediate reproduction
losatTips.body: The Gallery session contains the generated SVG and all input and layout settings. Use it when you want to inspect the completed figure immediately; regenerating after a setting change starts a new search.

losatTips.title: Use Safe or a fixed thread budget
losatTips.body: The CLI provenance uses 16 LOSATP threads. In the browser, Safe leaves logical CPUs available for the rest of the page.

losatTips.title: Keep all four input rows unchanged
losatTips.body: After you run LOSATP in your browser, changing a selected replicon, file, input order, or LOSAT threshold invalidates the corresponding browser cache entry.

losatTips.title: Expect an expensive first run
losatTips.body: Adjacent pairs evaluates four cross-record combinations across the one species-row boundary. Styling-only changes are much faster after the cache has been created.

troubleshooting.title: One chromosome is missing
troubleshooting.body: Compare the four Record selectors with the chromosome table. Each assembly must include both chromosomes.

troubleshooting.title: Species names repeat above every replicon
troubleshooting.body: Enter the species definition and strain subtitle only on the first replicon in each species row; leave both fields empty for the other replicons.

troubleshooting.title: Definitions contain extra lines
troubleshooting.body: Turn off Replicon, set Accession and Length / Coordinates to Hide, and keep Lock Definition Column on.

troubleshooting.title: The block colors do not match the Gallery
troubleshooting.body: Set LOSAT Mode to LOSATP, LOSATP mode to Collinear blocks, Color mode to Orientation + identity, and Evidence scope to Adjacent pairs.

troubleshooting.title: The browser becomes unresponsive
troubleshooting.body: Load the bundled session, switch LOSAT execution to Serial, or lower the thread budget before repeating the full search.
